segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the rollout plan for the analytics workspace and make sure the quote matches what your team needs for June.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re still at 84 seats for phase one. That’s 62 standard users, 18 managers, and 4 admins. If adoption looks good, we’d add the operations group in Q4.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The pricing sheet I sent Monday had 84 seats on an annual term starting June 24, with implementation services included as a one-time $7,500 line item. Does that still line up?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. Finance asked if the subscription invoice can be dated July 1, even if we start setup the week of June 24. Our budget opens July 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s workable. We can start implementation under the signed order form and set the first subscription invoice for July 1. The service fee would invoice on signature unless you need that moved too.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, services on signature is fine. The total annual subscription was $51,240, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. That’s after the 10% annual prepay discount. So $51,240 for the software, plus $7,500 for implementation, total first-year amount of $58,740 before any applicable tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Legal had one comment on the renewal language. They want 60 days’ notice instead of 30 if either side is changing the renewal count.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That should be fine. I’ll route that through deal desk and send back an updated order form today. No change to the commercial terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If we can get the final version by end of day, I can put it in front of our controller tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the revised order form and the implementation timeline together. Target kickoff would be June 25, admin training July 9, and go-live July 22.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send it over and I’ll reply if anything else comes up.
